text:
anika: quick thought — we should ship a tiny 'replay-tester' that simulates 429 storms, token rotation (401/403), and mid-stream drops for onboarding sampleapps. would catch a bunch of SDK parity bugs.
josh: yes please. what's the minimal behavior?
tereza: minimal CLI + proxy: accept requests, configurable response sequence (200, then 429, then 200), connection drop, or rotate token. opt-in header X-Redwood-Replay-Key to detect duplicates. simple /report JSON at end.
josh: +1 for replay key TTL option. dev default 5m, docs recommend 24h for prod idempotency.
anika: example curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/charge -H 'Authorization: Bearer LOCAL' -H 'X-Redwood-Replay-Key: demo-1' -d '{"amt":100}'
josh: SDK changes: node/python opt-in auto-add key, expose hook to override. go: KeyProvider interface. also surface a retry-warning when proxy marks a key as processed before 429.
tereza: CI idea — matrix of scenarios (token-rotate, 429-after-partial, mid-drop). fail CI if duplicate side effects detected.
ci-bot: scheduled: replay-tester/e2e nightly at 05:00 UTC, will post results to #devex.
anika: next steps: i'll prototype node proxy and /report. josh: draft SDK surface for node/python. tereza: sketch Go interface and CI job. goal: prototype before onboarding workshop. :rocket:
